insight: For Haiti, hydration breaks in the 2026 World Cup have been a welcome opportunity to regain momentum, with the team managing to gain momentum in 5 out of 6 breaks, resulting in a positive change of +0.133 minutes on average. This suggests that the breaks have allowed Haiti to recharge and come back stronger, which is particularly notable when they are not pressing before the break, as they have been able to maintain a positive momentum in these situations. In contrast, when Haiti was pressing before a break, they lost momentum, with a significant average decline of -0.400 minutes, indicating that they may have been exhausting themselves before the break. Overall, the data suggests that Haiti benefits from hydration breaks, especially when they are not expending extra energy before the break.
